name: silvershop-suite/address-lookup-loqate
description: Loqate (GBG) Capture provider for silvershop-suite/address-lookup (CMS 6): the GLOBAL satellite connector. Resolves addresses in 250+ countries via Loqate's two-step Find -> Retrieve autocomplete, and installs itself as the registry's global `default` so every country without a regional mapping (NZ, US, rest-of-world) autofills through Loqate. Consent-gated (third-party global processor) and paid per lookup; reads SS_LOQATE_API_KEY.

suggest.silvershop-suite/cookieconsent: Gates the Loqate lookup behind a consent category (default `marketing`); without it, the global fallback is default-deny until consent is assumed in config.
